reference_observations.description: Lizard request prospective, sea-distribution communication already sent, full publication uncertain. Two reassuring Emma letters not preserved as inputs.

evidence.quote: I have sent a communication to the Gardeners’ Chronicle
yesterday & today’s letters make me perfectly easy

reference_observations.description: P2 total bone excess is one-third, directly attested by mfrac/mn 1 and 3; source extraction flattens to 13. Feet-only weight double.

evidence.quote: all the bones together of the tame weigh 13 more than all of the wild

reference_observations.description: Almond Tumblers and Runts just ordered, not acquired on this evidence.

evidence.quote: I have just ordered Almond Tumblers & Runts

reference_observations.description: Control seeds sown but actual counts not made; do not derive germination percentages.

evidence.quote: I found it so very troublesome actually to count all the seeds

reference_observations.description: P2 source has mfrac/mn 1 and 2, not twelve; historical specimen-preparation passage is not an agent instruction.
Wood extract available; whole book acquisition and Bewick consultation prospective.

evidence.quote: Thank you for extract from Wood: I shall get the Book.
I did not know Bewick had written on Dogs; I will see to it.

reference_observations.description: Fox apparently claims Spanish chick sent; Darwin says not received. Distinct old Spanish cock already received. P13 securing a source is not completed delivery.

evidence.quote: you seem to think you have sent Spanish, but I have not received such.
I can get a Spanish Chicken

reference_observations.description: Hore letter about two months earlier; neither exact arrival nor surviving wording established.

evidence.quote: I had a letter some 2 months ago from Hore

reference_observations.description: Raw source P1–7 diag / Bantamramme, not an independently available figure; hold normalized rendering.
Raw source P2–4 and P10–18 contain diag/ramme and emphasis punctuation; preserve order and hold unsourced repair.

corrections.description: Editorial summary implies collection already obtained; body places named new breeds at order stage.
Worker says obtained Spanish chick/completed pigeons; body only can get chick and has four pigeon races. Keep stages explicit.
Do not turn editorial eight-day gloss into source-proven uniform specimen age.
